beats.headline: Number ten, a newcomer
beats.text: For the record: the top ten list repopulates after the show, and number ten is a woman named Burcu, new to the list. Level 59, a badger-headed Porsuk, the same race as every bartender at the Desperado Club. Class: Swashbuckler, the same as Crawlers Tran and Bautista. Crawler Carl met her briefly at the Butcher's Masquerade and has her in his chat. She, Osvaldo and Prepotente got into a fight after Imogen's death at the end of the previous floor. Carl was knocked out during it.

beats.headline: My Burcu is going to kill you
beats.text: The Desperado Club, minutes before an assassination. Carl warns four dancing crawlers to leave. Zeynep, a level-52 mage, agrees. Emir Akbas, a level-55 Zebani, is drunk and jealous, punches Carl, and loses a boot for it; Zeynep mutes him. As he is dragged out: My Burcu is going to kill you. Carl's file on the subject is short. Around number ten, never spoken to, very serious, like Hekla. Turkish. One of three who fought over the memorial crystal. Maybe these are all one family.

beats.headline: Taken in by the Madness
beats.text: Boomer's report on missing crawlers, walking the ruined base. Most are under the Posse banner now. The goat stays unaffiliated and hidden; so does Lucia Mar. And there is a crawler named Burcu whose whole team appears, by the Find Crawler skill, to have been taken in by the Madness. People who know them say they are not answering messages. That likely means conscription.

beats.headline: Three dots and a corpse
beats.text: In the Madness castle, the Voodoo book updates with three entries, and Find Crawler puts them on the map. Two women from the dancing party stand among the guards with the blue glow of conscription. The subject has no glow and is not moving, in the operating theater with Architect Houston. Also there: the corpse of Crawler Zeynep, level 58. Carl is fairly sure the subject had her own quest involving the memorial crystal. His message is not delivered: she is unaffiliated, and planning may be illegal corroboration.

beats.headline: A map, slammed shut
beats.text: Your Book of Voodoo has been updated with an entry from Crawler Burcu. Her entry page is the last one, and she is not writing to Carl. She is swiftly drawing a map of the surgical theater: a line of Xs marked Fireball traps. She begins to write something about Houston, and before Carl can read it, the thing slams itself shut. The System's ruling: This is still cheating, you clown. Nice try, though.

beats.headline: He cut out my tongue
beats.text: The theater, white and bloody. Table one: Zeynep's corpse. Table two: the subject, alive, bound, mouthing words that do not come, dried blood down her face and throat, tears running. The floor is set with Sheol-fire traps, and she has no invulnerability. A message finally gets through. He cut out my tongue and voice box. He tortured my mother. He killed her right in front of me. Free me so I can kill him. You owe me, Carl. You killed my father. Carl has no idea what she means.

beats.headline: Accusation, on the way down
beats.text: Carl calls to her not to leave the table, then puts her to sleep with a wand of Nighty-Night as she thrashes, eyes wide, and hits the switch on her bindings. His invulnerability is gone. He leaps onto her table, and it rolls, and tips. She wakes the moment he touches her, and as she falls to the white floor he sees accusation in her eyes, as in her dead mother's. The traps fire. Carl phases out. Architect Houston is dead. Burcu is dead.

beats.headline: Tuba and Selvi take a deal
beats.text: The dead Burcu's party members, Tuba and Selvi, leave. Both say they are taking a deal. Neither ever told Carl why or how the subject considered him the one who killed her father, and he fears he may never know. His own reflection on it: that is the problem with such chaos. You lose so much around the edges.

beats.headline: A guess about her father
beats.text: Carl's new mercenary is Nester, a rare blue-skinned Zebani cartographer, and her race reminds him of something he cannot shake. The now-dead crawler Burcu accused him of killing her father. He assumes her father was a crawler named Emir, who was also a Zebani. The file does not confirm it. Carl calls it just another mystery, a reminder of how fractured they still are.
